QuestInfo.name: Enhancing the Broken Core
QuestInfo.0: After plenty of daring-do, you got the Blue Ore the blacksmith asked for. You sense a strong, unusual energy within it. Seem like this could enhance the core, but can the blacksmith really do it himself? One way to find out...
QuestInfo.1: The blacksmith is working hard to enhance the broken core. Seeing him in action has eliminated all of your doubts; this guy is really good! It will be interesting to see how the core comes out.
QuestInfo.2: Your core is brimming with power! This means you've completed your 2nd Job Advancement! Better go find Burke and track down the last core. It's time to clear everything up once and for all!

npc.0: The core is so... sad. It's nowhere near its full potential.
